legal.question: Are election results legally valid?
legal.answer: Vocdoni produces a full, independently verifiable audit trail and a certified results document for every election. For most professional bodies, associations, and cooperatives across Europe, this meets the technical requirements for a valid online election. If your organization has specific statutory requirements, check with your legal adviser - and contact us if you need documentation.

anonymity.question: Can anyone see how members voted?
anonymity.answer: No. Votes are encrypted before they are cast. The final result is calculated without anyone - including Vocdoni - ever seeing individual choices.

setup.question: How long does it take to set up an election?
setup.answer: For the Vocdoni app, one person can set up a complete election in under 30 minutes. For tech-savvy teams looking for deep custom integration, we also offer an SDK to embed the voting protocol directly into your own infrastructure.

free.question: Is Vocdoni free?
free.answer: Yes, we offer Vocdoni voting technology through the Vocdoni app up to 100 members, with no credit card and no time limit. For larger organizations, our pricing is public on our website, ensuring you can scale your governance without hidden costs.

switch.question: We already use a digital voting tool. Why switch?
switch.answer: Most digital voting platforms produce a result and ask you to trust it. Vocdoni produces a result and proves it. Any member can independently verify the full outcome using a public record - not a PDF from our team, but a public proof that any auditor, lawyer, or member can inspect themselves. Our code is also publicly available for anyone to review.

dispute.question: What if a member disputes the result?
dispute.answer: The result is stored on a public, tamper-proof record. Any member can verify it independently - not by asking Vocdoni, but by checking the public proof themselves. In seven years of running elections, no Vocdoni result has ever been successfully challenged on grounds of integrity.

gdpr.question: Is it GDPR compliant?
gdpr.answer: Yes. All data is hosted in EU infrastructure. Individual votes are encrypted and never exposed - not to the organizer, not to Vocdoni. We are GDPR compliant and built for organizations that need strong evidence and clear operational controls.

techsavvy.question: What if some of our members are not very tech-savvy?
techsavvy.answer: Voters receive a link. They click it, see their ballot, make their choice, and submit. No account, no app download, no password. If it works on a smartphone browser, it works for your members.

voters_app.question: Do voters need to install an app or create an account?
voters_app.answer: No. Voters open a link in their browser and vote from any device. No account or password required.

vote_types.question: What kinds of votes can I run?
vote_types.answer: You can run single choice, multiple choice, weighted, approval, score, and multi-question votes from the same platform.

hybrid.question: Can I run in-person or hybrid votes too?
hybrid.answer: Yes. Vocdoni supports remote, in-person, and hybrid voting, allowing you to manage all participation through a single source of truth.

census.question: Can I use my existing voter list or CRM?
census.answer: Yes. You can import your members via CSV or sync them through our API if you already manage your census in another system.

open_source.question: Is Vocdoni open source?
open_source.answer: Yes. Our code is public and can be inspected by anyone, ensuring full transparency in how the voting protocol handles your data.

tamper_proof.question: How do I know the result hasn't been tampered with?
tamper_proof.answer: Results are stored on a public, tamper-proof record. Any member or auditor can verify the outcome independently using mathematical proofs, rather than just taking our word for it.

coercion.question: Can anyone force a member to vote a certain way?
coercion.answer: Vocdoni supports vote revision: members can change their choice as many times as they want while the vote is open. Only the last one counts, which helps mitigate coercion in digital environments.

accessibility.question: Is the platform accessible for all members?
accessibility.answer: We prioritize a clean, accessible interface that is WCAG AA compliant and works on any modern smartphone or computer browser, ensuring that every member can participate regardless of their technical ability.

items.question: Can I run in-person or hybrid votes too?
items.answer: Yes. Vocdoni supports remote, in-person, and hybrid voting.

items.question: What if my members are not very tech-savvy?
items.answer: The flow is simple: open the link, cast the vote, and submit it in the browser. No app and no password-heavy flow.

items.question: Where can I see proof of how Vocdoni works?
items.answer: You can read the technology page, open the public vote explorer, and inspect the open source code.

upload.title: 1. Upload your member base
upload.description: Import your voter list from a spreadsheet in seconds. Every member automatically receives a unique, private access link - no account or app required on their end.

create.title: 2. Create the voting process
create.description: Choose your voting method, write your question, and set start and end dates. Your ballot is configured and ready to go in under five minutes.

share.title: 3. Share the link, collect votes
share.description: Send the voting link by email. Members vote from any device in seconds. Results are published instantly when voting closes - anyone can verify the count is correct.
